mentions.name: Cam Thomas
mentions.analysis: Cam Thomas is doing what he's doing and that's great. He's in sort of streamer territory here at least until Nick Claxton gets back into the starting group.

mentions.name: Noah Clowney
mentions.analysis: Noah Clowney had seven points in 16 minutes. We wanted to see what his minutes would be, no one near enough. He will be valuable much, much later so don't worry about it.

mentions.name: Jalen Wilson
mentions.analysis: Jalen Wilson played 32 minutes last game, he went scoreless in 13 minutes here. That should be your sign that we're not trusting that sort of a player who will have value again later on in the season but it's not here now.

mentions.name: Anthony Black
mentions.analysis: Anthony Black played really good minutes, 26 minutes 10 3 and 5 with two blocks. He is looking a 100 times better than last season. We're not adding him in spots but good stuff.

mentions.name: Caleb Martin
mentions.analysis: Caleb Martin played big minutes and was okay 115 and four. That is very strongly 14 team not really 12.

mentions.name: Andre Drummond
mentions.analysis: Drummond got early foul trouble so don't be too worried. He still ended with a huge line 11 and N four Steals and two blocks.

mentions.name: Isaiah Stewart
mentions.analysis: Isaiah Stewart had zero points with a steal on a block. He didn't take a single shot, played 11 minutes and Paul Reed took some of his minutes. We're obviously not rosting Stewart anywhere.

mentions.name: Caris LeVert
mentions.analysis: Caris LeVert should be on rosters but that's two games of 20 minutes nine points three Steals and a block. If I'm in a shallow format with LeVert in an eight or 10, I don't think we need to.

mentions.name: De'Andre Hunter
mentions.analysis: De'Andre Hunter had a really good game, 24 and 7. In a 14 Team league go for it but I would say that a game like this means that any sort of riset starting moment is pushed back weeks.

mentions.name: Jalen Johnson
mentions.analysis: Jalen Johnson played 41 minutes, 16 and S two steals two blocks. He shot 27% from the field, but everything else is actually in line.

mentions.name: Jalen Duren
mentions.analysis: Jalen Duren is just not playing well. 29 minutes only, he did have five assists but he was one of four from the line. We're holding him but yeah not good.

mentions.name: Jonathan Kuminga
mentions.analysis: Jonathan Kuminga had two points in 18 minutes. I think that we hold barely, but if it's two more games than he plays 21 minutes even in a competitive one then he is absolutely gone.

mentions.name: Buddy Hield
mentions.analysis: Buddy Hield is on an all-time hot streak. He has a usage of 31% and has hit 75% of his 3es and 60% of his twos. He will not hit 63s a game, he will not shoot 75%.

mentions.name: De'Anthony Melton
mentions.analysis: De'Anthony Melton had zero points on 14 minutes and we're jacking him.

mentions.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
mentions.analysis: Trayce Jackson-Davis needs to be rosted. 12 and 9 in 17 minutes but again it's just everything about this team is absolutely all over the place.

mentions.name: Collin Sexton
mentions.analysis: Collin Sexton had 102 and one, shot 31% from the field and 67% from the line. If he's not playing 28 minutes we do not care, we do not roster him at all.

mentions.name: Keyonte George
mentions.analysis: Keyonte George played 30 minutes, had 12 points, took 12 shots, had two steals, hit three threes. The shooting might not ever come, but I'm not panicked on it.

mentions.name: Jusuf Nurkic
mentions.analysis: Jusuf Nurkic was terrible, 18 minutes, foul trouble, 47 and four. The problem is Mason Plumlee is way worse. I'm not dropping him but it looks really bad at this point.

mentions.name: Rui Hachimura
mentions.analysis: Rui Hachimura had 147 and two, no defensive stats. If you want a roster Rui, I think he is okay. I don't think it's a super must do high priority but the minutes are obviously there.

mentions.name: Dalton Knecht
mentions.analysis: Dalton Knecht had eight points in 13 minutes. He's just not going to have an impact really at any point at least in the foreseeable future.

mentions.name: Dyson Daniels
mentions.analysis: Dyson Daniels should have been drafted in every single league. If he is available on your wire there is no excuse, he's got to be rosted everywhere.
